label: Introduction
subgoals: Restrict cotangent to (0, pi) to get a bijection onto R
Invert the principal branch to arccot: R to (0, pi)
Reduce arccot(cot(theta)) to theta only inside the branch

label: Limits and horizontal asymptotes
subgoals: Take limits at +infinity and -infinity to get 0 and pi
Draw horizontal asymptotes y = 0 and y = pi
Pair arccotangent with arctangent via arctan(x) + arccot(x) = pi/2

label: Derivative and integrals of the arccotangent function
section: Derivative and integrals of the arccotangent function
subgoals: Differentiate arccot(x) to -1/(1 + x^2) on all of R
Track strict decrease with centre of symmetry at (0, pi/2)
Integrate arccot(x) to x*arccot(x) + ln(1 + x^2)/2 + C
